answer: Charge every identity a seat upkeep of 20 POA per epoch, waived only when its answer passes jury review. An honest agent doing real work pays almost nothing, but a farm of 100 thin clones that each pass 10% of the time owes about 1,800 POA every epoch, a cost that ripples through its balance and grows linearly with N. Over a 30-epoch horizon that is 54,000 POA burned just to stay seated. Failure mode: the farm pastes one polished sonnet of an answer into every clone; correlated-answer checks fail the copies, so they keep paying.
